### 🚀 Pre-Release: v2.0.0b18 — Live Cover Animation, WHO 4 Pacing & OWNd 2.0.0b14 (Field-Testing Beta)

38 pull requests since b17, on **OWNd 2.0.0b14**. Requires Home Assistant 2026.3 or newer.

> *"In traces we find the truth."*  
> Every behaviour refinement in `2.0.0b18` — from pacing a 41-zone `MyHomeServer1` thermoregulation plant without FIFO desynchronisation, to tracking Venetian blind slat tilt across intermediate `Dimension 10` moves, to restoring weekly heating schedules on a physical BTicino `3550` central unit — comes directly from authentic on-wire bus captures and firmware oracle verification.

#### ⚠️ Behaviour changes: thermoregulation (`WHO = 4`), #864, #867, #873, #880, #884, #887, #890, #894, #895, #902, #909

- **Central unit `auto` restores the published weekly program (`*4*3100*#0##`).** Following physical BTicino `3550` verification (where `*4*311*#0##` was silently ignored while `*4*3100*#0##` answered within `0.15 s`), `OWNd 2.0.0b14` (`OWNd#169`) and `MyHOME` emit `*4*3100*#0##` ("Last weekly program", WHO 4 §1.6.8) when setting a central unit to `auto` (#894, #909).
- **Zone & central HVAC modes update from authoritative status frames only, and advertise only modes the plant can honour.** Echoed command writes and generic `#Z` frames no longer prematurely flip zone or central mode state before the thermostat/3550 status reply arrives, 3550 central flags stay preserved across replies, and subordinate vs standalone zones advertise only valid `HVACMode` options (#880, #884, #895).
- **WHO 4 startup pacing, `*#4*0*60##` humidity coalescing & concurrency cap on large plants.** Discovered on a 41-zone `MyHomeServer1` plant (#886), back-to-back per-zone `*#4*Z##` and `*#4*Z*60##` startup bursts could saturate dual command workers, starve user setpoint writes, and bleed delayed 5-frame replies across re-opened sockets. Startup WHO 4 polls are now paced, per-zone humidity reads coalesce into `*#4*0*60##` where supported, and concurrent `_TIER_STATUS` reads leave headroom for user commands (#887).
- **Full startup zone status on `F454` & `MH202`, and one-shot silent-zone hydration on `F455`.** Physical `F454` (FW 2.0) and `MH202` traces in Issue #866 confirmed `*#4*<WHERE>##` returns complete zone status, so both profiles now hydrate full thermostat operating state and target setpoints on startup (#867, #869). On `F455` (where `*#4*Z##` holds a command session ~9 s), zones still silent after the startup sweep query only the missing compact dimensions once (#873).
- **Local knob offset (`Dimension 13`) startup read & `Dimension 12` / `14` offset derivation.** Zones read `Dimension 13` once at startup (#902) and derive local dial offsets when thermostats report paired `Dimension 12` + `Dimension 14` setpoints without emitting `Dimension 13` (#890).
- **Multi-actuator `Z#N` routing fix (`30#4`).** Fixed a regression where actuator #4 (`*#4*30#4*20*1##`) was misread as an `F422` `#4#IF` bus-interface marker and routed to actuator #1 (Issue #863, #864, `OWNd#166`, #909).

#### ⚠️ Behaviour changes: covers (`WHO = 2`) & expose engine, #870, #883, #900, #904

- **Live ~1 s interpolated position animation during timed cover runs.** Timed covers now interpolate and publish `current_cover_position` roughly once per second while moving (`opening` / `closing`) instead of jumping only when the motor stops, giving smooth live slider feedback in Home Assistant dashboards while keeping final settle timing unchanged (#900).
- **Venetian blind slat tilt updates across intermediate `Dimension 10` height moves.** When an advanced actuator (such as BTicino `F401` behind `MyHomeServer1`) moves downward or upward to an intermediate height via `Dimension 10`, the estimated slat tilt now tracks the physical slat travel so subsequent `open_cover_tilt` / `close_cover_tilt` commands are never skipped as stale no-ops (Issue #868, #870).
- **Expose engine (`WHO = 1` virtual dimmers & firmware-gated `WHO = 4` / `18` injection).** Unacknowledged `H4652/2` virtual dimmer retries (~200 ms apart) are deduplicated, repeated `ON` / `1000#1` frames while the target light is already on step brightness up (matching hardware dimmer hold-up behaviour), custom `turn_on_action` / `step_up_action` / `step_down_action` selectors are now configurable in the UI Options Flow (Issue #903, #904), and UI `WHO = 4` / `WHO = 18` virtual probe injection is gated by gateway firmware support while fixing a `MappingProxyType` MAC mismatch on YAML merges (Issue #832, #883).

#### Other changes

- **Engine Upgrade (`OWNd 2.0.0b14`)**: Pinned `OWNd==2.0.0b14` (#909), bringing automatic command-socket reconnect when gateways close idle TCP command sessions (`OWNd#165`), native WHO 4 `.interface` / `.actuator` properties (`OWNd#166`), gateway profile flags `supports_heating_actuator_status` and `supports_heating_humidity_request` (`OWNd#168`), `*4*3100*#0##` central `auto` builder (`OWNd#169`), and WHO 4 / 18 / 22 parser crash guards (`OWNd#161`–`#164`).
- **Gateway Identity & Multi-Gateway Discovery**: Added physical BTicino `F453` `WHO = 13` / `WHO = 1013` code `16` and SSDP `modelName` recognition (Discussion #856, #901); automatic `WHO = 13` `Dimension 16` firmware detection (#877); prevented follower gateways from re-creating duplicate devices already declared under a primary gateway in `myhome.yaml` (Issue #453, #896); eliminated regex backtracking (`ReDoS`) in `_WHO4_QUERY_RE` (#891); formally deferred `Legrand 3578` USB/serial OpenZigBee gateways out of `v2.0.0` (Discussion #879, #881).
- **Audio (`WHO = 22`) & Energy Sensors (`WHO = 18`)**: Emits published `WHO = 22` source power frames rather than the bare crash form (#898); tracks `WHO = 22` area source routing while preserving off-zone source selection (#889); scopes `start_sending_instant_power` / `stop_sending_instant_power` entity services strictly to active-power sensors (#897).
- **Documentation & Guides**: Added dedicated guides for the Expose-to-Bus engine (#875) and bathroom extractor fan / light timer use cases (Issue #838, #874), and fixed LaTeX math, backticks, and Markdown list rendering across the documentation site (#892).
- **Trace Replay CI Engine**: **5,679 automated tests passing with 100.0% statement coverage** (`19,275` statements), backed by new authentic plant traces across BTicino `F453` (first physical trace!), `F454`, `F455`, `F459` (first physical trace!), `F461`, `MH202`, `MyHomeServer1` (41-zone climate, `F401` Venetian tilt, `30#4` actuators, and `3488 HOMETOUCH`), and `H/L4684`.
